instructions: Native Screen records the screen and turns recordings into polished videos. Typical flow: get_status, then open_project or start_recording, get_project to read the document, edit with update_project / add_item / update_item / delete_item / split_item / run_action, check the result with render_frame, then export_video. Every edit is one undo step in the editor the user sees, and undo / redo are available. Times named source*Ms are positions in the original recording; timeline*Ms are positions in the edited video after cuts and speed changes (get_project returns the mapping in info.slices). Ids come from get_project. When project is omitted, the frontmost editor is used.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: What Native Screen is doing now: open projects (id, name, path, whether it is the frontmost editor, unsaved changes), the recording state (idle, picking, counting down, recording, paused, elapsed seconds) and exports in progress.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Projects on disk: recent projects and the .nativescreen packages in the projects folder, newest first.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Opens a .nativescreen project in an editor window (or brings it to the front) and returns its id.

tools.name: create_project_from_video
tools.description: Creates a new project from a movie file (no cursor or keystroke data, so no auto zooms) in the projects folder and opens it.

path.description: Absolute path of the movie file (mp4, mov, m4v...).

tools.name: close_project
tools.description: Saves the project and closes its editor window.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Moves the project package to the Trash and closes its window. This cannot be undone with undo; the user can restore it from the Trash.

tools.name: rename_project
tools.description: Renames the project and its package on disk.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Saves the project now (autosave may be off in Settings).

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: The project document as JSON (canvas, background, frameStyle, cursor, camera, motion, audio, captions, timeline) plus info: durations, the capture mode, what was recorded (camera, microphone, system audio, cursor, keystrokes), the playhead and info.slices with each clip's source and timeline range. The transcript words (captions.segments) are left out unless include_transcript is true.

include_transcript.description: Include captions.segments (every transcript word). Default false.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Changes the document with a JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386) against the JSON from get_project: objects merge, null removes an optional value, arrays are replaced whole. Use it for settings such as background, frameStyle, cursor, camera, motion, audio, canvas and caption styles. For one timeline item use update_item instead of replacing an array. One undo step.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Adds a timeline item and returns its id. zoom, mask, annotation, camera_layout, caption and shortcut need sourceStartMs and sourceEndMs. mask goes on trackId or the first mask track free at that time (a new track if none). annotation (text or an arrow drawn over the video, see annotationKind) goes the same way on the annotation tracks and starts in the middle of what is visible at sourceStartMs; set position01 (text) or from01/to01 (arrow) in properties. With anchor "screen" (the default) those points use the recording's coordinates like masks and follow zooms; with anchor "canvas" they are 0...1 of the output frame. caption goes on trackId, on a new track when trackId is "new", or on the first caption track (created if needed). shortcut is a custom keystroke on trackId or the first shortcut track. shortcut_track adds an empty track; caption_track adds a track holding one "New caption" at the playhead, because a caption track is never empty (to start a track with your own caption, add a caption with trackId "new"). properties is a merge patch applied to the new item, e.g. {"scale":2.2,"mode":"manual","manualCenter01":{"x":0.3,"y":0.4}} for a zoom.

text.description: caption or text annotation: its text.

imagePath.description: image annotation: an image file on this Mac, copied into the project.

annotationKind.description: annotation: what it draws. Default text. image needs imagePath. rectangle, ellipse and pen are sized by size01 around position01 and zoom with the recording when pinned to the screen; steps number themselves in time order. pen is a freehand stroke: points01 inside its box (0...1, top-left), optional pointTimesMs (one per point, ms after the first) so the draw animation replays it at that speed, and highlighter for a wide see-through marker. Strokes drawn on the screen while recording arrive as pen, arrow and rectangle items on a Live drawing track.

maskType.description: mask: blur hides sensitive data, spotlight highlights. Default blur.

rect01.description: mask: area in the recording, 0...1 from the top left. Default a centered box.

layoutType.description: camera_layout: one of the values from list_options kind enums (CameraTimelineLayoutType). Default cameraOverlay.

primaryKey.description: shortcut: the main key, e.g. K, Return, Space.

properties.description: Merge patch applied to the new item.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Changes one timeline item or track with a JSON Merge Patch against its JSON in get_project. Kinds: slice (timeline.slices: speed, volumes, muted, hideCursor, source range), zoom (timeline.zooms), mask (items inside timeline.maskTracks), annotation (items inside timeline.annotationTracks; {"layer": "front" | "forward" | "backward" | "back"} moves it between layers, the first track drawing on top), camera_layout (timeline.cameraLayouts), voiceover (timeline.voiceovers; fileOffsetMs is where it starts in its audio file), caption (captions.captionBlocks; {"text": "..."} sets the caption text), caption_track, mask_track, annotation_track, shortcut_track, custom_shortcut (captions.customShortcuts). One undo step.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Deletes a timeline item or a whole track with everything on it. Item kinds: slice, zoom, mask, annotation, camera_layout, voiceover, caption, shortcut (a shortcut cluster id from get_project info.shortcuts). Track kinds: caption_track, mask_track, annotation_track and shortcut_track (id is the track's id), voiceover_track (id is the track index, 0 based), camera_layouts_track (id is ignored). One undo step.

tools.name: split_item
tools.description: Splits a clip, zoom, mask, annotation, caption, camera layout or voiceover in two at a timeline time. Splitting a slice and deleting one half is how to cut a part of the recording.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undoes the last edit, like Cmd+Z in the editor.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redoes the last undone edit.

tools.name: render_frame
tools.description: Renders one frame of the edited video as a PNG (background, zoom, cursor, camera, captions, keystrokes, exactly as exported) and moves the editor's playhead there. Use it to check an edit.

tools.name: run_action
tools.description: One-off editor commands. regenerate_auto_zooms replaces the zooms with ones made from the recorded clicks and typing. generate_transcript transcribes the voice on device and fills captions (it runs in the background; poll get_project until info.isGeneratingTranscript is false). remove_filler_words and tighten_pauses need a transcript. reset_cuts restores the whole recording as one clip. scan_sensitive_data and scan_faces add blur masks automatically. play and pause control the editor preview.

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Values the document accepts: wallpapers (names for set_background), mesh_presets (background.meshPresetId), cursor_themes (cursor.themeId), presets (apply_preset), background_music (audio.backgroundMusic.relativePath), enums (every enum field and its allowed values).

tools.name: set_background
tools.description: Sets the background to a wallpaper by name (from list_options wallpapers), an image file, a mesh preset, a solid color or a two-color gradient. For other background settings use update_project.

imagePath.description: Absolute path of an image file; it is copied into the project.

tools.name: apply_preset
tools.description: Applies a saved style preset (from list_options presets) to the project.

tools.name: list_capture_targets
tools.description: What can be recorded: displays, windows (front to back), cameras, microphones and apps playing audio.

tools.name: start_recording
tools.description: Starts a recording of a display, a window, an area or only the camera, with the recording bar and the countdown from Settings (the user sees it). A camera recording captures no screen and no system audio; in its project the camera is the main picture (info.captureMode is camera). Returns at once; the recording runs until control_recording stop. Omitted options keep the recording bar's current choice.

displayId.description: display: from list_capture_targets. Default the main display.

rect.description: area: global screen points, origin at the top left of the main display.

cameraId.description: Camera to record, or null for none.

microphoneId.description: Microphone to record, or null for none.

tools.name: control_recording
tools.description: Controls the recording in progress. stop finishes it, creates the project, opens it and returns its id. restart throws away what was recorded and starts again. cancel stops and deletes the recording; it cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: App settings: general (appearance, language, launchAtLogin), recording (countdownSeconds, afterRecording, autoCreateZooms, hideDesktopIcons, hideDockIcon, highlightRecordedArea, cameraMaxResolution), editing (useLastProjectSettings, autosave, projectsDirectory, presetsDirectory) and quickExport.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.description: Changes app settings with a merge patch against get_settings. A language change applies after the app restarts.

tools.name: export_video
tools.description: Exports the edited video and waits until it is done (progress notifications are sent when the client asks for them). target file writes outputPath (default: the Desktop, named after the project); target clipboard copies the file to the clipboard. config overrides the defaults: format (mp4, prores, gif), fps, resolutionHeight, compression, mp4Codec, proResProfile, gifHighQuality, gifDisableLoop. Values a format does not allow are adjusted, and the result lists what was used.

outputPath.description: Absolute path. An existing file is replaced.

useQuickExportSettings.description: Start from the Quick export settings instead of the export defaults.

tools.name: export_frame
tools.description: Saves one frame of the edited video as a PNG or JPEG file.

project.description: Project id from get_status, or the path of a .nativescreen package (opened if needed). Default: the frontmost editor.
